feed.title: Cross-Show

bullets: Macro forecasting is mostly humility plus a few dependable signals — the second-order effect is the part most people miss.
Reliability of data trumps cleverness of model; the framing matters because it tells you which tradeoffs you are making.
The version of the question that actually matters centers on reliability — that's where the conversation gets interesting because reliability tradeoffs crosscut everything else.
The pattern of humility plus dependable signals has played out at teams using Bloomberg NEF and IPCC.
The most underrated piece of macroeconomics is that reliability of data trumps cleverness of model.
A practical next step is to pick one of the covered ideas and run it for two weeks — the rest is iteration.
